sources.title: Qwen Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an official platform from Qwen that empowers both everyday users and developers with unified access to Qwen's series of open-source and proprietary models. It offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbots, image and video understanding, image generation and editing, document processing, tool utilization, voice and video chat, and artifacts.

sources.title: OpenAI's 'Astra' Model Gets a Private Washington Preview
sources.snippet: OpenAI privately previewed its next generation of AI models to policymakers and regulators in Washington, D.C. this week, according to The Information. The model family, tentatively named "Astra," is designed for long-running, multi-agent tasks — a meaningful step beyond the GPT-5.6 series the company released in June and July.
